about: Enumerated option lists that must be the same, in the same order, on every app (the UI contract). Values are the case ids; the tests and parity/check.py fold them to lowercase letters and digits, so iambicA, IAMBIC_A and Iambic A all compare equal. Read by the Kotlin tests on android and desktop, by the Swift harness for the lists MorseKit exposes (paddleModes, answerEntryModes, answerEntryTiers, qsoExchangeModes), and by parity/check.py for all of them (the iOS app-target enums are not visible to the harness, so only the static check reads those). Add a list here when a new enumerated setting is added to the apps, and register its enum locations in parity/sources.json.
